universe_basis: Previously saved Sept21 105-name research universe plus fixed earnings/AI/high-volatility candidates before current prices are viewed; not full market or survivorship-free historical universe
target: actual current entry -> exit in regular session today, net gain at least5%
liquidity_filter: last regular close>=5 and previous20day average dollar volume>=50million
screen_rank_rule: ATR14/close*100 + 0.5*clipped latest relative return vs QQQ (percentage points, -5 to5); descriptive volatility/momentum rank, not calibrated chance
historical_investigation: top12 eligible by frozen screen rule; full remaining-session path from completed 09:15 five-minute bar close, all historical targets exclude today, conservative stop-first if target/stop touched in same bar; no parameter search
snapshot_time: 09:20 ET; full 09:15 bar completed; current missing bar excludes historical probability
two_strategy_branches: VICR event/right-tail: known primary catalyst + tail opportunity
LRCX oversold-in-trend: close>SMA200 and Wilder RSI2<=20 and three-day return<0
certification: no high-win-rate claim without independent prospective audit, costs, actual bid/ask; trade-path frequency distinguished from high-touch frequency
